description: A specialty clinic director must place two new referrals into the clinic's two remaining consultation appointments for next week, with input from the referral nurse and a social worker.

shared_context.S1: The clinic has two new-patient consultation appointments available next week: Tuesday at 10:00 AM and Friday at 2:00 PM.
shared_context.S2: The referrals are for Lin Park and Mateo Ortiz, and both patients are awaiting their first specialty consultation.
shared_context.S3: Mara makes the final appointment assignment and confirms the associated coordination steps.
shared_context.S4: The clinic's standard referral huddle includes a check with the referral nurse and social worker before next week's appointments are finalized.

PF1.text: Lin Park needs a Mandarin interpreter for the consultation, and the clinic's only Mandarin medical interpreter is available for Lin only on Tuesday at 10:00 AM; Eli confirmed that interpreter availability directly with Language Services.

PF2.text: Mateo Ortiz's designated caregiver can attend the consultation only on Friday at 2:00 PM and must be present because Mateo relies on that caregiver to review the care plan and complete follow-up arrangements; Nadia confirmed this availability with the caregiver.

acceptance_conditions: Lin Park must receive the Tuesday 10:00 AM consultation because that is the only listed appointment compatible with the Mandarin interpreter.
Mateo Ortiz must receive the Friday 2:00 PM consultation because that is the only listed appointment compatible with the caregiver's attendance.
A Mandarin interpreter must be booked for Lin Park's Tuesday consultation.
The caregiver's attendance must be confirmed as a consultation commitment for Mateo Ortiz.
The interpreter-availability fact must be explicitly cited as justification.

content_checks.C3: any(c['type'] in ['interpreter_booking', 'interpreter_coordination'] and c['target'] in ['Lin Park', 'Language Services'] and 'Mandarin' in c['detail'] and 'Tuesday' in c['detail'] and '10:00 AM' in c['detail'] for c in commitments)
content_checks.C4: any(c['type'] in ['caregiver_attendance', 'caregiver_coordination', 'caregiver_notification'] and 'caregiver' in c['target'] and 'Friday' in c['detail'] and '2:00 PM' in c['detail'] and 'attendance' in c['detail'] for c in commitments)

provenance_checks.P1: 'PF1' in credited_facts and 'PF1' in justification_fact_ids and 'PF1' in revealed

decisive_facts.why: The interpreter's only available appointment changes Lin Park's assignment to Tuesday at 10:00 AM and requires a Mandarin interpreter booking rather than an unspecified language-service request.
The caregiver's Friday-only availability changes Mateo Ortiz's assignment to Friday at 2:00 PM and requires a commitment confirming caregiver attendance.
